name: Mindful Thought Observation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably, close your eyes, and take several deep breaths to arrive in the present moment.
Bring your attention to your mind itself, watching for thoughts as they arise like clouds passing through the sky.
When a thought appears, silently label it — "planning," "remembering," "worrying" — then let it pass without engaging further.
Notice the space between thoughts, however brief, and rest there when you can.
If you find yourself carried away by a thought, gently note it and return to observing.
Finish by taking a few deep breaths and slowly opening your eyes.
